profileLabel: Restrictive on speech and drug enforcement; mixed on institutions (medium-low confidence)
summary: Leyte 4th District representative with 174 principal-authored bills. Authored a ban on confidential funds for non-security agencies, an anti-dynasty ban, dangerous drug courts, stronger drug control, penalties for malicious false information and medical cannabis access. Also authored two bills postponing barangay and SK elections and two fixing their terms, plus travel-tax abolition.
caveat: Medical cannabis is a single social issue and unscored. Civil-liberties score rests on bills with enforcement rationales. Barangay-election postponement bills were widely co-sponsored.
